pitch: Trek through deciduous and coniferous biomes, matching animal adaptations with 'so they can' and 'instead of'.
targetFormula: Animals adapt so they can survive. They have [A] instead of [B].
topic: Two Different Forests nonfiction, deciduous vs coniferous trees, 4 seasons, leaf loss, needles, cones, hibernation, temperature

arc.discovery: Phase 1: Biome Satellite Scan tracks temperatures and seasonal foliage across deciduous and coniferous biomes.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: Ranger Field Station tests pupil teams on animal adaptations, heading identification, and contrast grammar.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Forest Ranger Teleprompter challenges teams to broadcast a 3-sentence wildlife adaptation briefing.

mechanics: Smartboard biome expedition. Teams toggle between green deciduous woods and snowy coniferous taiga. Correct choices advance the rover. Soft-fail offers an ecological clue without deducting team points.

softFail: Check the temperature! Is it mild or below minus 50? ❄️
Think: do these trees have broad leaves or needles? 🍃
Remember: 'instead of' replaces the second item! 🔄
'So they can' explains the reason or purpose! 🎯
Reread the section heading for the clue! 📖
feedback.levelUp: Forest Ranger Station upgraded to Senior Biome Warden! 🌲👑

smartboard.boardActions: Ranger teams tap large branch cards, sort animals into biome zones, and drag sentence connecting tiles.
smartboard.classParticipation: Desks show 'D' (Deciduous) or 'C' (Coniferous) with arm signals before the board player confirms.
smartboard.version15min: 10 rounds covering forest characteristics and adaptation matching.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round championship with heading navigation, temperature charts, and teleprompter ranger briefings.
